verdict.rationale: Gram ships an official documented CLI (`gram`) for authenticating, staging OpenAPI/Functions sources, pushing and monitoring deployments, and installing toolsets as MCP servers into agents, with an explicit self-update mechanism — corroborated by a dedicated reference page and probe confirmation. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the CLI beyond first-party docs, and no changelog/version history evidence of ongoing CLI maturity.
